title: Information-Directed Sampling for Causal Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2607.15577v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causal bandits exploit structural relationships among variables to share information across interventions and accelerate the identification of high-reward decisions. In many applications, however, some variables cannot be directly manipulated, even though they influence the reward and provide useful information about the underlying causal system. We study contextual causal bandits with non-manipulable variables, where context variables are observed before action selection and additional variables are observed after each intervention. Assuming a known causal graph without latent confounding, we adopt a Bayesian formulation in which the conditional probability tables of the observational distribution constitute the unknown parameter. This representation allows observations collected under one intervention to update reward estimates for other interventions through their shared causal mechanisms. We develop causal variants of Thompson Sa

translated_title: 面向因果老虎机的信息导向采样
translated_abstract: 因果老虎机利用变量之间的结构关系在干预之间共享信息，从而加速识别高回报决策。然而在许多应用中，某些变量无法被直接操控，尽管它们会影响奖励并提供关于底层因果系统的有用信息。我们研究了带有不可操控变量的情境化因果老虎机，其中情境变量在动作选择之前被观察到，而额外的变量在每次干预之后被观察到。在假设因果图已知且不存在潜在混杂因子的情况下，我们采用贝叶斯公式，将观测分布的条件概率表视为未知参数。这种表示方式使得在某次干预下收集的观测数据能够通过共享的因果机制来更新其他干预的奖励估计。我们开发了汤普森采样的因果变体……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对存在不可操控变量的情境化因果老虎机，提出了基于贝叶斯框架的信息导向采样方法，利用共享的因果机制在干预之间传递信息，从而加速识别高回报决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes information-directed sampling for contextual causal bandits with non-manipulable variables, using a Bayesian framework in which shared causal mechanisms propagate information across interventions to accelerate the identification of high-reward decisions.
